questions.question: List ki main properties?
questions.answer: Ordered, mutable collection. Duplicates allowed hote hain aur mixed data types rakh sakti hai.
questions.explanation: See model answer.

questions.question: List indexing strings jaisi hai?
questions.answer: Haan. Index 0 se start aur negative indexing end se. Slicing bhi same pattern follow karti hai.
questions.explanation: TIP: 20-30 sec me clearly bolo. 20-30 sec me clearly bolo.

questions.question: Nested list kya hai?
questions.answer: List ke andar list. 2D table/matrix jaisa structure represent kar sakti hai.
questions.explanation: See model answer.

questions.question: b = a aur b = a.copy() me fark?
questions.answer: b=a same object ka alias hai. copy() nayi shallow list banata hai.
questions.explanation: TIP: 20-30 sec me clearly bolo.

questions.question: sum/min/max/sorted ka role?
questions.answer: Numeric list par aggregate aur sorted result nikalne ke built-ins hain. sorted original ko change nahi karta.
questions.explanation: TIP: 20-30 sec me clearly bolo.

questions.question: List mutable hone ka practical impact?
questions.answer: Ek reference se change karoge to same list ke doosre aliases par bhi effect aa sakta hai.
